strings.Frost glitters on its hide: a Rime Glea: 霜花在牠身上閃爍：霜之輝光！
strings.It glows like the last of the sun: a Du: 牠像落日餘暉般發光：暮金輝光！
strings.It is washed in deep ink: an Inkwash Gl: 牠浸染著濃墨：墨染輝光！
strings.Its colours never hold still: an Opalin: 牠的顏色從不停歇：蛋白石輝光！
strings.Rarer Gleams show their own mark:: 更稀有的輝光有自己的標記：
